title: PowerToys does not check for a newer version (B) if it has already notified that a new version (A) is ready
summary: The advertised PowerToys update may remain stale when a newer release becomes available.

judgment.rationale: The report gives an actionable scenario, but current behavior and the failing boundary are unverified.
evidence: On 0.97.2 the reporter saw 0.99.0 offered after 0.99.1 became available and could not force an update check without restarting.
The reporter was unsure whether automatic downloading was enabled and suggested keeping a manual check available.
Inspected src/runner/UpdateUtils.cpp CheckForUpdatesCallback, which obtains GitHub version information and passes it to ProcessNewVersionInfo.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build and identify the first failing stage before choosing a targeted correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction may be applicable after current behavior and its boundary are confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate stale offered update versions
proposed_fixes.root_cause: An update state or UI gating condition may keep an earlier offer visible; the exact current path is unverified.
plan: Reproduce sequential available versions in a controlled update feed without installing the first offer.
Trace automatic and manual check gating, update state and downloaded-file handling.
Choose a refresh behavior that preserves valid downloads and respects prerelease, network and policy settings.
Add tests for successive release metadata, failed refresh and an already-downloaded installer.
verification: An undownloaded older offer can be refreshed to a newer eligible release.
Downloaded installers and policy or prerelease choices are not silently invalidated.

confidence.rationale: The reported scenario is concrete but the current-build behavior and failing stage remain unknown.

reproduce.title: Investigate stale offered update versions
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare the reported version if practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test environment and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Use a controlled test update feed or equivalent test seam representing installed version X and available versions A then B.
steps: 1. Start on X with automatic download disabled and publish eligible version A to the test feed.
2. Observe the offered A without downloading or installing it.
3. Publish eligible version B, invoke any available manual check or wait for the scheduled check, and inspect update state.
4. Repeat with A already downloaded and with a failed metadata refresh.
reproduce.expected_result: The update state reflects a newer eligible version without losing a valid download or bypassing user and policy choices.
